cpcb_health_statement: Air quality is considered satisfactory, and air pollution poses little or no risk.
potential_health_effects: Minimal health impact for general population.
exercise_guidance: Ideal conditions for outdoor physical activity and exercise.
personal_protection_actions: Enjoy outdoor activities. No special precautions required.
indoor_air_management: Keep windows open for natural ventilation during daytime.

cpcb_health_statement: Minor breathing discomfort to sensitive people; acceptable for general public.
potential_health_effects: May cause mild discomfort to individuals with existing respiratory ailments.
exercise_guidance: Generally safe for outdoor sports; unusually sensitive individuals should monitor symptoms.
personal_protection_actions: Sensitive groups should consider reducing prolonged intense outdoor exertion.

cpcb_health_statement: Breathing discomfort to people with lungs, asthma, and heart diseases.
potential_health_effects: Associated with mild irritation in eyes, throat, and increased coughing.
exercise_guidance: Consider moving high-intensity outdoor workouts indoors, especially near heavy traffic.
personal_protection_actions: Wear well-fitted filtration masks (e.g. N95) during prolonged traffic commutes.
indoor_air_management: Close windows during morning & evening rush hours; utilize air filtration.

cpcb_health_statement: Breathing discomfort to most people on prolonged exposure; illness on prolonged exposure to people with heart disease.
potential_health_effects: May aggravate asthma, trigger coughing, shortness of breath, and cardiovascular fatigue.
exercise_guidance: Avoid prolonged high-intensity outdoor exercise; exercise indoors in filtered spaces.
personal_protection_actions: Limit outdoor transit during peak traffic hours; wear certified N95/N99 respirators.
indoor_air_management: Keep windows closed; run HEPA air purifiers; avoid burning incense or open fires.

cpcb_health_statement: Respiratory illness on prolonged exposure. Effect may be more pronounced in people with lung and heart diseases.
potential_health_effects: Elevated risk of acute respiratory distress, severe bronchial inflammation, and reduced lung capacity.
exercise_guidance: Discontinue outdoor exercise and strenuous sports; stay in clean indoor environments.
personal_protection_actions: Vulnerable individuals (children, elderly, respiratory/cardiac sensitive) should stay indoors.
indoor_air_management: Operate air purifiers on high; seal drafts; avoid unnecessary travel.

cpcb_health_statement: Affects healthy people and seriously impacts those with existing diseases.
potential_health_effects: Severe respiratory inflammation, systemic cardiovascular stress; high risk for all individuals.
exercise_guidance: Zero outdoor physical exertion. Avoid all non-essential outdoor presence.
personal_protection_actions: Mandatory respiratory protection if transit unavoidable; vulnerable groups must remain in air-purified rooms.
indoor_air_management: Schools & offices advised to shift to remote mode; continuous HEPA filtration.
